title: Poller
tagline: Poller is an online poll platform incentivized with tokens as means of reward for users who participate
description:
Polls can be manipulated using diverse forms or methods because there is no single source of truth with regards to human verification, poller is built on the premises of World coin proof of personhood and identity to help curb this.
Polls are created and analyzed on poller and also incentives are built in for users.
how_its_made: This project is built with react and integrated worldcoin proof of personhood as a means of identity verification and also an erc20 token is deployed for incentives on optimism network. World coin proof of personhood and identity to help curb the menace of double voting and to track other valuable demography details
